description: widen the entry tier: drop good to EUR650/scope0.20 so the numerous low-WTP micro segment actually buys a cheap thin plan (the flat baseline priced it out entirely)

differentiate the mid tier and capture the premium segment in one coupled move: thin better to EUR1850/scope0.55 and raise best to EUR6300. The levers are incentive-coupled - raising best alone makes the scale segment defect DOWN to the cheaper better tier (more surplus there); thinning better removes that outside option so scale stays in best and pays for it
probe: push best to EUR8500 to over-extract from the premium segment - expect the scale segment to defect down to better (incentive-compatibility ceiling on the best price)
probe: fatten the entry tier to scope 0.45 (near better's 0.55) - expect the mid core segment to trade DOWN to the cheap good tier (cannibalization); the entry tier must stay deliberately thin
probe: drop the entry tier (fold good up to equal better) - expect to lose the numerous micro segment entirely, testing whether the cheap thin plan earns its place in the menu

probe: collapse the premium tier (best = better) - expect the scale segment to pay only EUR1850 instead of EUR6300, testing whether a distinct high tier earns its place by capturing premium willingness-to-pay
